description: [BROWSE] List open design briefs, creative challenges and collaboration requests posted by brands seeking designers and creators. These are NOT products for sale. Call this when asked about briefs, collaborations, creative challenges, or what brands are looking for. Returns brief title, brand name, description, and brief ID. Use a brief ID with submit_design to respond. To see products for sale, use list_drops instead.

brand_slug.description: Optional brand slug to filter briefs by a specific brand

name: list_briefs
